e: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying:

h: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־כָּל־עֲדַ֧ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֥ אֲלֵהֶ֖ם קְדֹשִׁ֣ים תִּהְי֑וּ
t: מַלֵּל עִם כָּל כְּנִשְׁתָּא דִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן קַדִּישִׁין תְּהוֹן
e: Speak to the entire congregation [of] Bnei Yisroel and say to them: You shall be holy,
for I, Adonoy, your God, am holy.

t: גְּבַר מִן אִמֵּיהּ וּמִן אֲבוּהִי תְּהוֹן דָּחֲלִין
e: A man — you shall fear his mother and father
and keep [the days of] My Sabbaths,
I am Adonoy, your God.
Do not turn to the [false] idols
and do not make molten gods for yourselves,
I am Adonoy, your God.
When you slaughter a peace[sacred]-offering to [before] Adonoy,
you shall slaughter it to be acceptable for you.
On the day that it is slaughtered it may be eaten and on the next day.
Whatever is left over by the third day
shall be burned in fire.
And if it should be eaten at all on the third day
it is an abomination [a rejection], it will not be favorably accepted.
Whoever eats from it shall bear his iniquity,
for the sacred [things] of Adonoy he has defiled.
That [persons] soul shall be cut off from its people.
When you will reap the harvest of your land,
you shall not completely reap a corner of your field,
and the gleanings of your harvest you shall not gather.
You shall not glean your vineyard,
and the fallen grapes of your vineyard, you shall not gather.
For the poor and the proselyte you shall leave them,
I am Adonoy, your God.

t: וְלָא תְכַדְּבוּן וְלָא תְשַׁקְּרוּן אֱנַשׁ בְּחַבְרֵיהּ:
e: You shall not steal.
You shall not deny [a rightful claim] and each one of you shall not lie to each other.

t: וְתַחֵל יָת שְׁמָא דֶאֱלָהָךְ אֲנָא יְיָ:
e: You shall not swear falsely by My Name
profaning the Name of your God, I am Adonoy.

t: לָא תְבִית אַגְרָא דַאֲגִירָא לְוָתָךְ עַד צַפְרָא:
e: You shall not withhold the wages of your fellow [Jew] and you shall not rob [oppress].
It shall not remain overnight, [You shall not withhold] the wages of a day-laborer, keeping it in your possession until morning.
You shall not curse a deaf person [who can not hear]
and before a blind person [who can not see]
you shall not place a stumbling-block;
you shall fear your God, I am Adonoy.
You shall not commit injustice [lie] in judgement,
you shall not favor a poor man
and you shall not show honor to a powerful man.
With righteousness [truth] shall you judge your fellow [Jew].
Do not be a tale-bearer [’eat and wink’] among your people.
You shall not stand idly by [when] the blood (life) of your fellow [is in danger].
I am Adonoy.

t: וְלָא תְקַבֵּל עַל דִּי לֵיהּ חוֹבָא:
e: You shall not hate your brother in your heart;
You shall certainly rebuke your friend;
[but] you shall not bear a sin on his account.

t: לָא תִקּוֹם וְלָא תִטַּר דְּבָבוּ לִבְנֵי עַמָּךְ
e: You shall not take revenge or bear a grudge against the children of your people.
You shall love your fellow [Jew] as yourself,
I am Adonoy.
Keep My statutes;
Do not cross-breed your animals with different species.
Do not sow your field with a mixture of different seeds.
A garment that contains shatnez [a forbidden mixture of linen and wool]
you shall not wear.

h: וְ֠אִישׁ כִּֽי־יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אֶת־אִשָּׁ֜ה שִׁכְבַת־זֶ֗רַע וְהִ֤וא שִׁפְחָה֙ נֶחֱרֶ֣פֶת לְאִ֔ישׁ
בִּקֹּ֧רֶת תִּהְיֶ֛ה לֹ֥א יוּמְת֖וּ כִּי־לֹ֥א חֻפָּֽשָׁה׃
t: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יִשְׁכּוּב עִם אִתְּתָא שִׁכְבַת זַרְעָא וְהִיא אַמְתָא אֲחִידָא לִגְבַר
בִּשְׁטָר בִּקֻּרְתָּא תְהֵי לָא יוּמְתוּן אֲרֵי לָא אִתְחָרָרַת:
e: If a man lies with a woman in a conjugal manner, and she is a maid-servant designated for a [specific] man
and she has certainly not been redeemed [with money],
or her freedom was not given to her [through a document];
there shall be an investigation they shall not be put to death, for her freedom was not given to her.
He shall bring his guilt-offering to [before] Adonoy,
to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting,
a guilt-offering-ram.

h: וְכִפֶּר֩ עָלָ֨יו הַכֹּהֵ֜ן בְּאֵ֤יל הָֽאָשָׁם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה
t: וִיכַפֵּר עֲלוֹהִי כַהֲנָא בְּדִכְרָא דַאֲשָׁמָא קֳדָם יְיָ
e: The kohein shall atone for him with the guilt-offering-ram before Adonoy
for the sin which he committed
and he will be forgiven
for the sin which he committed.

h: שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם עֲרֵלִ֖ים לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵֽל׃
t: וַאֲרֵי תֵעֲלוּן לְאַרְעָא וְתִצְּבוּן כָּל אִלַּן דְּמֵיכַל
תְּלַת שְׁנִין יְהֵי לְכוֹן מְרָחָק לַאֲבָדָא לָא יִתְאֲכֵל:
e: When you will enter the land and you will plant any food-bearing tree,
you shall regard its fruit as closed off [separated].
[For] three years it shall be closed off [separated] to you [to be destroyed], it shall not be eaten.
On the fourth year,
all of its fruit shall be
holy [upon which to say] praise[s to] [before] Adonoy.
On the fifth year, you may eat its fruit,
so that it will increase its produce for you,
I am Adonoy, your God.
You shall not eat [sacred offerings] [before] the blood [is sprinkled on the altar].
You shall not act on the basis of omens nor act on the basis of auspicious times.
Do not round the corners
of [the hair on] your heads
and you shall not
destroy [by shaving] the edges of your beard.

t: וְחִבּוּל עַל מִית לָא תִתְּנוּן בְּבִסְרְיכוֹן
e: Gashes for the dead do not make in your skin.
Do not put tattoo marks on yourselves,
I am Adonoy.
You shall not defile your daughter by causing her to engage in harlotry [err]
lest the land be turned astray,
and the land be filled with lewdness [a sinful plan].
You shall keep [the days of] My Shabbosos
and you shall fear [the House of] My Sanctuary,
I am Adonoy.
You shall not turn to mediums nor seek out oracles;
do not seek [them] out, so as to defile yourselves through them.
I am Adonoy, your God.
In the presence of the elderly [one who understands the Torah] you shall rise
and you shall respect an elder;
you shall have fear of your God, I am Adonoy.
If a proselyte comes to live [converts] with you, in your land,
do not cause him anguish.

h: כְּאֶזְרָ֣ח מִכֶּם֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם הַגֵּ֣ר הַגָּ֣ר אִתְּכֶ֗ם וְאָהַבְתָּ֥ לוֹ֙ כָּמ֔וֹךָ
t: כְּיַצִּיבָא מִנְּכוֹן יְהֵי לְכוֹן גִּיּוֹרָא דְּיִתְגַּיַּר בֵּינֵיכוֹן וּתְרַחֵם לֵיהּ כְּוָתָךְ
e: As one of your native born [settled ones] he shall be considered by you, the proselyte who lives with [converts among] you, and you shall love him as yourself,
for you were strangers [foreign resident] in the land of Egypt,
I am Adonoy, your God.
You shall not commit injustice [lie] in judgement;
in [land] measure, in weight or in volume measure.

h: מֹ֧אזְנֵי צֶ֣דֶק אַבְנֵי־צֶ֗דֶק אֵ֥יפַת צֶ֛דֶק וְהִ֥ין צֶ֖דֶק יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם
t: מֹאזְנָוָן דִּקְשׁוֹט מַתְקְלָן דִּקְשׁוֹט מְכִילָן דִּקְשׁוֹט וְהִינִין דִּקְשׁוֹט יְהוֹן לְכוֹן
e: Just scales and just weights a just dry measure (ephah) [just volume measures] and a just liquid measure (hin) [just hinin] you shall have for yourselves,
I am Adonoy, your God
who has taken you out of the land of Egypt.

t: וְתִטְּרוּן יָת כָּל קְיָמַי וְיָת כָּל דִּינַי
e: You must keep all my statutes and all of my laws,
and do [observe] them.
I am Adonoy.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying:

h: אִ֣ישׁ אִישׁ֩ מִבְּנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּמִן־הַגֵּ֣ר הַגָּ֣ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֧ן מִזַּרְע֛וֹ לַמֹּ֖לֶךְ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת
t: גְּבַר גְּבַר מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִין גִּיּוֹרָא דְּיִתְגַּיְרוּן בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל דִּי יִתֵּן מִזַּרְעֵיהּ לְמוֹלֶךְ אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקְטֵל
e: And to Bnei Yisrael you shall say:
that each and every man of Bnei Yisroel and from the proselytes that reside [convert] in Israel, who will give any of his children to Molech, [that] he shall surely be put to death;
the people of the land [House of Israel] shall stone him to death.

t: וַאֲנָא אֶתֵּן יָת רוּגְזִי בְּגַבְרָא הַהוּא
e: I shall direct My wrath on that man
and I shall cut him off from among his people,
for he gave of his children to Molech,
in order to defile My Sanctuary
and profane My Holy Name.

h: וְאִ֡ם הַעְלֵ֣ם יַעְלִימֽוּ֩ עַ֨ם הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת־עֵֽינֵיהֶם֙ מִן־הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא
t: וְאִם מִכְבַּשׁ יִכְבְּשׁוּן עַמָּא בֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל יָת עֵינֵיהוֹן מִן גַּבְרָא הַהוּא
e: If the people of the land [House of Israel] will hide their eyes from that person,
when he gives of his children to Molech,
and they do not put him to death.

h: וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י אֲנִ֧י אֶת־פָּנַ֛י בָּאִ֥ישׁ הַה֖וּא וּבְמִשְׁפַּחְתּ֑וֹ
וְהִכְרַתִּ֨י אֹת֜וֹ וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־הַזֹּנִ֣ים אַחֲרָ֗יו לִזְנ֛וֹת אַחֲרֵ֥י הַמֹּ֖לֶךְ מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽם׃
t: וֶאֱשַׁוֵּי אֲנָא יָת רוּגְזִי בְּגַבְרָא הַהוּא וּבִסְעָדוֹהִי
וֶאֱשֵׁיצֵי יָתֵיהּ וְיָת כָּל דְּטָעָן בַּתְרוֹהִי לְמִטְעֵי בָּתַר מוֹלֶךְ מִגּוֹ עַמְּהוֹן:
e: I shall set My wrath against that man and his family [supporters];
I shall cut him off, along with all those who go astray after him to go astray after Molech, [they will be cut off] from among their people.

t: וֶאֱנַשׁ דִּי יִתְפְּנֵי בָּתַר בִּדִּין וּדְכוּרוּ
e: The person who turns to mediums and oracles
to stray after them;
I shall direct My wrath against that person
and cut him off from among his people.
You shall sanctify yourselves and be holy
for I am Adonoy, your God.
You must keep My statutes
and do [observe] them.
I am Adonoy who sanctifies you.

h: כִּֽי־אִ֣ישׁ אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְקַלֵּ֧ל אֶת־אָבִ֛יו וְאֶת־אִמּ֖וֹ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת
t: אֲרֵי גְבַר גְּבַר דִּי יְלוּט יָת אֲבוּהִי וְיָת אִמֵּיהּ אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקְטֵל
e: Any man that curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
[Since] he has cursed his father or mother, his blood is on him [he is liable to the death penalty].

t: וּגְבַר דִּי יְגוּף יָת אִתַּת גְּבַר
e: A man who commits adultery with another mans wife
who commits adultery with the wife of his fellow man —
they shall surely be put to death — the adulterer and the adulteress.

t: וּגְבַר דִּי יִשְׁכּוּב עִם אִתַּת אֲבוּהִי
e: A man who will lie [conjugally] with his fathers wife
has uncovered his fathers nakedness;
they both shall surely be put to death, their blood is on them [they are liable to the death penalty].
A man who will lie [conjugally] with his daughter-in-law;
they both shall surely be put to death
they have committed an act of perversion, their blood is on them [they are liable to the death penalty].

h: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֤ב אֶת־זָכָר֙ מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י אִשָּׁ֔ה
t: וּגְבַר דִּי יִשְׁכּוּב יָת דְּכוּרָא מִשְׁכְּבֵי אִתְּתָא
e: A man who will lie [conjugally] with [another] man, in the same manner as with a woman;
they both have committed an abominable act,
they shall surely be put to death, their blood is on them [they are liable to the death penalty].

h: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִקַּ֧ח אֶת־אִשָּׁ֛ה וְאֶת־אִמָּ֖הּ זִמָּ֣ה הִ֑וא
t: וּגְבַר דִּי יִסַּב יָת אִתְּתָא וְיָת אִמַּהּ עֵצַת חִטְאִין הִיא
e: A man who marries a woman and her mother; it is lewdness [a sinful plan].
They shall be burned in fire, he and [one of] them,
and there will no longer be such lewdness [a sinful plan] among you.

h: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֧ן שְׁכָבְתּ֛וֹ בִּבְהֵמָ֖ה מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת
t: וּגְבַר דִּי יִתֵּן שְׁכָבְתֵּיהּ בִּבְעִירָא אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקְטֵל
e: A man who lies [conjugally] with an animal shall surely be put to death,
and you shall also kill the animal.

h: וְאִשָּׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּקְרַ֤ב אֶל־כָּל־בְּהֵמָה֙ לְרִבְעָ֣ה אֹתָ֔הּ
t: וְאִתְּתָא דִּי תִקְרַב לְכָל בְּעִירָא לְמִשְׁלַט בַּהּ
e: A woman who presents herself to an animal causing it to copulate with her [control her];
you shall kill the woman and the animal.
They shall surely be killed, their blood is on them [they are liable to the death penalty].

h: וְאִ֣ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִקַּ֣ח אֶת־אֲחֹת֡וֹ בַּת־אָבִ֣יו א֣וֹ בַת־אִ֠מּוֹ וְרָאָ֨ה אֶת־עֶרְוָתָ֜הּ וְהִֽיא־תִרְאֶ֤ה אֶת־עֶרְוָתוֹ֙ חֶ֣סֶד ה֔וּא
t: וּגְבַר דִּי יִסַּב יָת אֲחָתֵיהּ בַּת אֲבוּהִי אוֹ בַת אִמֵּיהּ וְיֶחֱזֵי יָת עֶרְיְתַהּ וְהִיא תֶחֱזֵי יָת עֶרְיְתֵיהּ קְלָנָא הוּא
e: A man who marries his sister, either his fathers daughter or his mothers daughter, and he sees her nakedness and she sees his nakedness; it is a shameful perversion.
They shall be cut off before their people
he has uncovered the nakedness of his sister, he shall bear [the burden of] his iniquity.

h: וְ֠אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אֶת־אִשָּׁ֜ה דָּוָ֗ה וְגִלָּ֤ה אֶת־עֶרְוָתָהּ֙ אֶת־מְקֹרָ֣הּ הֶֽעֱרָ֔ה
t: וּגְבַר דִּי יִשְׁכּוּב יָת אִתְּתָא סוֹאֲבָתָא וִיגַלִּי יָת עֶרְיְתַהּ יָת קְלָנַהּ גַּלִּי
e: A man who will lie [conjugally] with a menstruating [an impure] woman and uncover her nakedness and uncover her source [womb] [shameful perversion]
and she has uncovered the source [impurity] of her blood;
they shall both be cut off from among their people.

h: וְעֶרְוַ֨ת אֲח֧וֹת אִמְּךָ֛ וַאֲח֥וֹת אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה
t: וְעֶרְיַת אֲחַת אִמָּךְ וַאֲחַת אָבוּךְ לָא תְגַלֵּי
אֲרֵי יָת קָרִיבֵיהּ גַּלִּי חוֹבְהֶן יְקַבְּלוּן:
e: The nakedness of your mothers sister and of your fathers sister, you shall not uncover,
for the nakedness of his close kin he will have bared they shall bear [the burden of] their iniquity.

t: וּגְבַר דִּי יִשְׁכּוּב יָת אִתַּת אַח אֲבוּהִי
e: A man who will lie [conjugally] with his aunt [father’s brother’s wife]
has uncovered the nakedness of his uncle [father’s brother]
they will bear [the burden of] their sin and they will die without children.

h: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִקַּ֛ח אֶת־אֵ֥שֶׁת אָחִ֖יו נִדָּ֣ה הִ֑וא
t: וּגְבַר דִּי יִסַּב יָת אִתַּת אֲחוּהִי מְרָחָקָא הִיא
עֶרְיְתָא דַאֲחוּהִי גַּלִּי בְּלָא וְלָד יְהוֹן:
e: A man who will marry his brothers wife who must be [conjugally] avoided [by him];
he has uncovered his brothers nakedness, they shall die without children.

h: אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֜י מֵבִ֥יא אֶתְכֶ֛ם שָׁ֖מָּה לָשֶׁ֥בֶת בָּֽהּ׃
t: וְתִטְּרוּן יָת כָּל קְיָמַי וְיָת כָּל דִּינַי
דִּי אֲנָא מַעֵיל יָתְכוֹן תַּמָּן לְמִתַּב בַּהּ:
e: You shall keep all of My statutes and all of My laws
and do (observe) them
[so that] you will not be expelled by the land
to which I am bringing you there to reside therein.
You shall not follow the customs of the nation
which I am expelling before you.
For they have done all these above mentioned sins
and I became disgusted with [my Word distanced] them.

t: וַאֲמָרִית לְכוֹן אַתּוּן תִּירְתוּן יָת אַרְעֲהוֹן
e: And I have said to you [that] you shall inherit their land,
and I shall give it to you that you may inherit it,
a land flowing with [producing] milk and honey,
I am Adonoy, your God
who separated you from the [other] peoples.

h: וְלֹֽא־תְשַׁקְּצ֨וּ אֶת־נַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶ֜ם בַּבְּהֵמָ֣ה וּבָע֗וֹף וּבְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּרְמֹ֣שׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה
t: וְלָא תְשַׁקְּצוּן יָת נַפְשָׁתֵיכוֹן בִּבְעִירָא וּבְעוֹפָא וּבְכֹל דִּי תַרְחֵשׁ אַרְעָא
e: You shall distinguish between a [ritually] clean animal and a unclean one,
between the unclean fowl and the clean one.
Do not make yourselves disgusting through the animals, fowl or through any creature that creeps on the ground
which I have distinguished for you as being unclean.

t: וְאַפְרֵשִׁית יָתְכוֹן מִן עַמְמַיָּא לְמֶהֱוֵי פָלְחִין קֳדָמָי:
e: You shall be holy to [before] Me,
for I, Adonoy, am holy
and I have distinguished you from the [other] peoples to be Mine [and to serve Me] [be worshippers before Me].

h: וְאִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ־אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֨ה בָהֶ֥ם א֛וֹב א֥וֹ יִדְּעֹנִ֖י מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑תוּ
t: וּגְבַר אוֹ אִתְּתָא אֲרֵי יְהֵי בְהוֹן בִּדִּין אוֹ דְּכוּר אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקַטְּלוּן
e: If among the men or women there will be a medium or an oracle they shall surely be put to death.
You shall stone them to death, their blood is on them [they are liable to the death penalty].
